description:
Our team builds the real-time audio and video software behind features such as AirPlay, FaceTime and Screen Sharing, used by more than a billion people. We are looking for a proactive engineer to bring Machine Learning (ML) to these features, with models that learn on device while protecting user privacy. You will also apply AI to how we build software, creating agents and tools that make our engineers more productive. 

Description
You will apply ML across our media ecosystem, from training and evaluating models to integrating them on device and measuring their impact in the real world. The role also includes building AI agents that make our engineers more productive, from writing and fixing code to automating ML experimentation. Working closely with software, quality, ML and infrastructure teams, you will take ideas from prototype to product.

Responsibilities
Identify new use cases for ML across our media ecosystem, and develop and train models that improve the user experience.
Build and operate training pipelines and experiments to evaluate models and configurations and guide decisions with data.
Integrate models into the product and validate that they run reliably on device, within quality and power budgets.
Analyze real-world data to measure the impact of deployed models over time.
Design, build and operate AI agents that improve developer productivity, such as automated coding and bug fixing, triage, test failure analysis and code review assistance.
Automate ML development with agents that launch experiments, run training and evaluation, and identify the most promising models.
Partner with engineering, quality, ML and infrastructure teams to deliver projects from design to launch and drive adoption of shared tools.

Minimum qualifications
Experience in training and evaluating ML models, gained through industry roles, internships, research, open-source or independent projects.
Proficiency in Python and common ML frameworks such as PyTorch.
Proficiency in at least one systems language such as C, C++, Objective-C or Swift.
Practical experience in writing and using AI agents.
BS, MS or PhD in Computer Science, Electrical or Computer Engineering, ML or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred qualifications
Experience in deploying ML models on device or in latency-sensitive applications.
Experience in automating ML workflows, such as hyperparameter search, experiment orchestration or AI agents that design, run and evaluate experiments.
Familiarity with reinforcement learning or federated learning.
Experience in defining evaluation benchmarks and metrics for ML models or systems built on large language models (LLMs).
Experience in audio, video or networking technologies such as media streaming, wireless playback, screen sharing or real-time communication.
Experience in building multi-agent systems or agentic workflows, such as automated coding agents, planning, tool use and evaluation loops.
Experience in collaborating with cross-functional partners and communicating technical work clearly to engineers and stakeholders.
We encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every qualification.
